scope: Mechanism-neutral bottle-handling functional requirements for an upright D48 x H180 benchmark bottle. This model defines required or intentionally permitted rigid-body DOF behavior; it does not claim that current CAD geometry satisfies it.

source_basis.dimensional_identity_note: D48_H180 is encoded in the deterministic benchmark part identity; this requirements model does not independently remeasure those dimensions.

translation_flow.definition: Along the product transport path through the label-application station.

translation_cross_flow.definition: Horizontal displacement transverse to product flow at the application station.

translation_vertical.definition: Vertical displacement relative to the product support plane.

rotation_wrap_axis.definition: Rotation about the bottle's upright longitudinal axis used for circumferential label wrapping.

rotation_tilt_flow.definition: Bottle tilt in the vertical/flow plane.

rotation_tilt_cross_flow.definition: Bottle tilt in the vertical/cross-flow plane.

state_requirements.rationale: One intended bottle must remain positioned at the application station before capture is authorized.

translation_flow.reason: Prevent uncontrolled departure from the indexed application position.

translation_cross_flow.reason: Keep the bottle within a defined lateral application-position tolerance; exact tolerance remains unresolved.

translation_vertical.reason: Maintain the upright bottle on a support plane against gravity.

rotation_wrap_axis.reason: Wrap rotation is not required merely to be indexed; whether it is held or free before capture is architecture-dependent.

rotation_tilt_flow.reason: Prevent loss of upright product stability while indexed.

rotation_tilt_cross_flow.reason: Prevent loss of upright product stability while indexed.

state_requirements.rationale: The bottle must remain spatially captured while the mechanism establishes controlled bottle rotation.

translation_flow.reason: Prevent uncontrolled transport through the station during controlled capture/rotation.

translation_cross_flow.reason: Maintain the required capture/contact relationship transverse to product flow.

translation_vertical.reason: Maintain vertical product support throughout capture.

rotation_wrap_axis.reason: Circumferential bottle rotation is the functional motion required for wrap labeling.

rotation_tilt_flow.reason: Avoid tip/lean that would invalidate label-transfer and support relationships.

rotation_tilt_cross_flow.reason: Avoid tip/lean that would invalidate label-transfer and support relationships.

state_requirements.rationale: The bottle must remain in a controlled pose while label media transfers from the presentation region to the bottle.

translation_flow.reason: Bottle motion must not invalidate the label-transfer relationship; exact allowable synchronized motion is unresolved.

translation_vertical.reason: Maintain label-height relationship and upright support.

rotation_wrap_axis.reason: Rotation may be required during transfer and must remain compatible with label presentation; exact phase relation remains unresolved.

state_requirements.rationale: The bottle undergoes controlled circumferential rotation while required wrap contact remains valid.

translation_flow.reason: Prevent uncontrolled axial product motion that would break wrap/contact geometry.

translation_cross_flow.reason: Maintain required normal/contact relationship to the selected wrap mechanism.

translation_vertical.reason: Maintain stable vertical support through the wrap interval.

rotation_wrap_axis.reason: This is the required product rotation for circumferential wrapping.

rotation_tilt_flow.reason: Maintain bottle uprightness and label-path coherence.

rotation_tilt_cross_flow.reason: Maintain bottle uprightness and label-path coherence.

state_requirements.rationale: The completed bottle must cease being captured and become able to leave the station without an uncontrolled fall or blocked path.

translation_flow.reason: The bottle must regain transport freedom needed to leave the station.

translation_cross_flow.reason: Prevent uncontrolled lateral escape while allowing the exit path.

translation_vertical.reason: Maintain stable support during release/exit handoff.

rotation_wrap_axis.reason: Wrap rotation is no longer functionally required after completion; whether residual rotation is allowed or actively stopped is unresolved.

rotation_tilt_flow.reason: Maintain upright product stability during release.

rotation_tilt_cross_flow.reason: Maintain upright product stability during release.

cross_state_invariants: No mechanism family is implied by this DOF model.
The bottle must not lose required vertical support in any scoped state.
The wrap-axis rotation is intentionally available only as controlled functional motion where wrapping/transfer requires it; point contact alone does not establish control.
Restraint requirements describe needed behavior, not proof that a current contact, roller, belt, wall, stop, or Prism component provides it.
Exact tolerances, forces, friction coefficients, contact pressure, compliance, drive speed, acceleration, and phase timing remain unresolved until separately evidenced.
explicitly_not_established: which current CAD contacts are required versus incidental
exact CAD-axis mapping of the mechanism-neutral functional axes
